question: Which of the following union territories has the lowest literacy rate according to the 2011 census?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dadra and Nagar Haveli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In Western India, **Dadra and Nagar Haveli **is a union territory.
 
• According to the 2011 census, it is the union territory with the** lowest literacy rates** ever recorded.
 
• The overall literacy rate in **Dadra and Nager Haveli **is 77.24 percent.
